cards.ex: He ascended to power through a series of strategic alliances and shrewd political maneuvering.
cards.exUz: U bir qator strategik ittifoqlar va ayyor siyosiy harakatlar orqali hokimiyatga ko'tarildi.
cards.uzDef: Hokimiyatga erishish, yuqori lavozimga chiqish jarayoni.

cards.ex: The manager must exercise authority fairly and consistently to maintain discipline.
cards.exUz: Menejer intizomni saqlash uchun hokimiyatni adolatli va izchil ravishda amalga oshirishi kerak.
cards.uzDef: O'z huquq va vakolatlaridan foydalanib, boshqaruvni amalga oshirish.

cards.ex: Her research began to yield influence in policy debates.
cards.exUz: Uning tadqiqotlari siyosiy bahslarda ta'sir ko'rsata boshladi.
cards.uzDef: Boshqalarga ta'sir o'tkazish, fikrini o'zgartirishga yordam berish.

cards.ex: He used his political clout to push through the controversial legislation.
cards.exUz: U bahsli qonunchilikni olg'a surish uchun o'zining siyosiy nufuzidan foydalandi.
cards.uzDef: Siyosatda katta ta'sirga ega bo'lish, kuchli aloqalarga ega bo'lish.

cards.ex: The decision was made under the influence of powerful lobbyists.
cards.exUz: Qaror kuchli lobbichilarning ta'siri ostida qabul qilindi.
cards.uzDef: Birovning yoki bir narsaning ta'siri ostida bo'lish.

cards.ex: The company is currently embroiled in a fierce power struggle between different factions.
cards.exUz: Kompaniya hozirda turli guruhlar o'rtasida shiddatli hokimiyat uchun kurashga botgan.
cards.uzDef: Hokimiyatni egallash yoki saqlab qolish uchun kurash.

cards.ex: The country has a strong sphere of influence in the region.
cards.exUz: Mamlakatning mintaqada kuchli ta'sir doirasi mavjud.
cards.uzDef: Birov yoki bir guruh ta'sir o'tkaza oladigan hudud yoki soha.

cards.ex: People in positions of authority must act responsibly and ethically.
cards.exUz: Hokimiyat lavozimlarida bo'lgan odamlar mas'uliyatli va axloqiy harakat qilishlari kerak.
cards.uzDef: Boshqaruv yoki rahbarlik lavozimlarida ishlash.

cards.ex: The company flexed its muscles by acquiring its smaller competitor.
cards.exUz: Kompaniya o'zining kichikroq raqobatchisini sotib olib, o'z kuchini ko'rsatdi.
cards.uzDef: O'z kuchini, ta'sirini namoyish qilish.

cards.ex: The investigation revealed widespread abuse of power within the department.
cards.exUz: Tekshiruv bo'limda hokimiyatni keng tarqalgan suiiste'mol qilishni aniqladi.
cards.uzDef: Hokimiyatdan noto'g'ri, g'arazli maqsadlarda foydalanish.

cards.ex: The activists are exerting pressure on the government to take action on climate change.
cards.exUz: Faollar hukumatga iqlim o'zgarishi bo'yicha chora ko'rish uchun bosim o'tkazmoqdalar.
cards.uzDef: Birovga biror narsa qilish uchun tazyiq o'tkazish.

cards.ex: He was portrayed as a power-hungry politician willing to do anything to win.
cards.exUz: U g'alaba qozonish uchun hamma narsaga tayyor bo'lgan hokimiyatparast siyosatchi sifatida tasvirlangan.
cards.uzDef: Doimiy ravishda hokimiyatga intiluvchi, hokimiyatni sevuvchi.

cards.ex: She's a power player in the tech industry, known for her innovative ideas.
cards.exUz: U texnologiya sanoatida kuchli o'yinchi, o'zining innovatsion g'oyalari bilan tanilgan.
cards.uzDef: Katta ta'sirga ega bo'lgan, muhim rol o'ynaydigan shaxs.

cards.ex: Decisions are made in the corridors of power, far removed from the concerns of ordinary citizens.
cards.exUz: Qarorlar oddiy fuqarolarning tashvishlaridan uzoqda, hokimiyat yo'laklarida qabul qilinadi.
cards.uzDef: Hukumat yoki tashkilotning yuqori darajalaridagi joylar.

cards.ex: The politician has a vested interest in maintaining the status quo.
cards.exUz: Siyosatchi mavjud holatni saqlab qolishdan manfaatdor.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsadan shaxsiy manfaatdorlik.

cards.ex: He was accused of influence peddling after securing lucrative contracts for his friends.
cards.exUz: Do'stlari uchun daromadli shartnomalar olganidan so'ng, u ta'sir savdosida ayblangan.
cards.uzDef: O'z ta'siridan noqonuniy foyda olish.

cards.ex: The new strategy helped turn the tide and improve the company's performance.
cards.exUz: Yangi strategiya vaziyatni o'zgartirishga va kompaniyaning faoliyatini yaxshilashga yordam berdi.
cards.uzDef: Qiyin vaziyatni ijobiy tomonga o'zgartirish.

cards.ex: The CEO seemed to be losing his grip on the company as profits declined.
cards.exUz: Daromad kamayishi bilan bosh direktor kompaniya ustidan nazoratni yo'qotayotgandek tuyuldi.
cards.uzDef: Vaziyat ustidan nazoratni yo'qotish.

cards.ex: The senator used his political leverage to secure funding for the project.
cards.exUz: Senator loyiha uchun mablag 'olish uchun o'zining siyosiy ta'siridan foydalangan.
cards.uzDef: Siyosiy maqsadlarga erishish uchun foydalaniladigan ta'sir kuchi.

cards.ex: Women deserve a seat at the table when it comes to policy decisions.
cards.exUz: Ayollar siyosat qarorlari qabul qilinayotganda o'ringa ega bo'lishga loyiqdirlar.
cards.uzDef: Muhim qarorlarni qabul qilishda ishtirok etish huquqiga ega bo'lish.

cards.ex: The dictator moved quickly to consolidate power after the coup.
cards.exUz: Diktator to'ntarishdan so'ng o'z hokimiyatini mustahkamlash uchun tezda harakat qildi.
cards.uzDef: O'z hokimiyatini yanada kuchaytirish va barqarorlashtirish.

cards.ex: The dictator ruled the country with an iron fist, suppressing all dissent.
cards.exUz: Diktator mamlakatni temir musht bilan boshqarib, barcha noroziliklarni bostirdi.
cards.uzDef: Shiddatli, shafqatsiz boshqaruv usuli.

cards.ex: It's rumored that he's the one pulling the strings behind the scenes.
cards.exUz: Mish-mishlarga ko'ra, u sahnada ipni tortayotgan shaxs.
cards.uzDef: Ochiqchasiga ko'rinmaydigan, yashirin ta'sir o'tkazish.

cards.ex: As the saying goes, power corrupts, and absolute power corrupts absolutely.
cards.exUz: Aytganlaridek, hokimiyat buzadi, mutlaq hokimiyat esa mutlaqo buzadi.
cards.uzDef: Hokimiyat odamlarni yomonlashishiga olib keladi.

cards.ex: We must hold our leaders accountable for their decisions.
cards.exUz: Biz rahbarlarimizni o'z qarorlari uchun javobgarlikka tortishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Birovning harakatlari uchun javob berishini ta'minlash.

cards.ex: Her testimony helped tip the scales in favor of the defendant.
cards.exUz: Uning ko'rsatmasi ayblanuvchining foydasiga tarozini og'dirishga yordam berdi.
cards.uzDef: Birovning foydasiga qaror qabul qilinishiga ta'sir o'tkazish.

cards.ex: The military coup was seen as a blatant power grab.
cards.exUz: Harbiy to'ntarish ochiq-oydin hokimiyatni tortib olish sifatida ko'rildi.
cards.uzDef: Hokimiyatni zo'ravonlik yoki noqonuniy yo'llar bilan egallashga urinish.

cards.ex: The treaty aimed to maintain the balance of power in the region.
cards.exUz: Shartnoma mintaqada kuchlar muvozanatini saqlashga qaratilgan edi.
cards.uzDef: Turli guruhlar yoki davlatlar o'rtasidagi kuchlar taqsimoti.

cards.ex: The manager gave the team free rein to develop the new product.
cards.exUz: Menejer jamoaga yangi mahsulotni ishlab chiqish uchun erkin ixtiyor berdi.
cards.uzDef: Birovga cheklanmagan erkinlik va hokimiyat berish.

cards.ex: She's in charge of the marketing department.
cards.exUz: U marketing bo'limiga javobgar.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsa uchun mas'ul bo'lish.
